name: commitment_evidence_query
why: The proposed promise tracker cannot safely decide whether an uttered commitment was completed using generic browser/Mac actions alone. It needs one least-privilege, provenance-preserving query that searches only explicitly bound tabs/apps and returns evidence candidates without mutating anything.

target.description: Specific tab/session URL pattern or app/path binding

status: Granted as a schema and not resolvable to anything real (unresolved). Calling it returns that verdict and the nearest real capabilities, not an action.
note: If this tool takes an enum, each value resolves separately — one branch can be live while another is not.
